identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-01][readiness] Reconcile plans, sprint umbrellas, and parallel execution

review_prompts: Does every sprint have one real umbrella and a complete non-overlapping child set?
Do canonical docs agree with live issue, PR, card, and dependency truth?
Are parallel assignments collision-safe and dependency-correct?
Did WP-01 avoid implementation and scope expansion?
Are external-agent and merge authorities correctly bounded?

findings.summary: The crosswalk counted the Feature band table header, leaving only 122 real feature decisions
Keyword first-match classification produced semantically false feature owners instead of explicit row decisions
The validator and retained review history overstated semantic remediation by proving only heuristic consistency

residual_risk: Runtime v2 deletion remains forbidden until all real feature rows have explicit reviewed owner and disposition decisions.
